reason: A browser-side DeepSeek web client UI enhancement that displays pricing-period status and optionally highlights the composer during peak periods, with a locally persisted display-intensity setting.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek 网页客户端显示峰谷时段状态，并按设置在高峰时段高亮输入卡片。
summaries.en: Displays peak and off-peak status in the DeepSeek web client and optionally highlights the input card during peak periods.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek web client input card appearance
Displays peak/off-peak status information in the interface
Reads the selected model name and browser time
Stores display intensity settings in browser localStorage
